shipReasons: No critical defect and no regression against live r56: the Valefor rig is on in FFX and FFX-2 with no console error and no 400, Kimahri and Lulu stay on, all three rigs verify against the mirror, and FFX-2 Besaid plays to Victory on both builds.

Both targets of the change are met: Valefor's KO no longer jumps in size (head jump 0.2 percent against 25.8 percent live; frames show a full-size crouch against a shrunken bird), and Slow on Seymour Flux draws IMMUNE where live r56 draws MISS, while evaded, nullified and wrong-state misses still draw MISS.
The failing continuity findings (R57-001, R56-002, and the harness blind spot R57-002) are not introduced by this change and measure the same or better than live: disclosed and carried forward.
